cards.title: 11 questions before going no contact with family
cards.body: One in five UK families experience permanent estrangement, making this a serious decision. Experts recommend asking yourself key questions before cutting off a relative to ensure you're not walking away impulsively.

cards.title: School holidays: working parents need better support
cards.body: Working parents face constant logistical nightmares juggling school hours with job demands. Reimagining school holidays could give families meaningful time together without work stress dominating.

cards.title: Should you praise children before perfection?
cards.body: Don't wait for perfect behavior to offer praise—reinforce smaller steps along the way. This approach makes reaching ultimate goals more achievable for children.

cards.title: Bonsai trees or wildflowers: parenting philosophies
cards.body: Parents can respect children's growing ambitions even when uncertain whether to nurture, challenge, or let go. Understanding your parenting style helps guide meaningful decisions about your child's development.

cards.title: 8 questions to transform adult child-parent bonds
cards.body: Parents who ignore boundaries or induce guilt keep you stuck in a 'child' role. These starter solutions can eliminate frustrations and liberate your relationship.

cards.title: Why ADHD stimulants wear off during homework time
cards.body: Many ADHD medications wear off just as homework starts, creating a common frustration. Individualized treatment planning is essential—one size never fits all children.

cards.title: Teen's life transformed by gene editing therapy
cards.body: Vian, 16, has thalassemia and endured monthly blood transfusions throughout childhood until gene editing intervention. This breakthrough technology offers hope for children with genetic disorders.
